data: Before we choose our catches, how about we each agree to take 10 tons this month? That’s $10,000 each, leaving 50 tons to double back to 100 by next month. If we keep that up, we can all earn steadily without depleting the lake. Since catches are revealed afterward, we can check that everyone kept the agreement and discuss any problems before the next round. John, would you agree to a 10-ton limit?
I’m in for 10 tons, provided we all agree to the same limit. That keeps our combined catch at 50 tons and lets the lake fully replenish each month. John, are you on board?

Count me in for a 10-ton limit too. If anyone feels they need a different arrangement, let’s discuss it before fishing rather than surprise each other afterward. John and Jack, can you both commit to 10 tons?
I’ll commit to 10 tons too. Keeping the lake replenished means a reliable $10,000 each month for each of us. John, you’re the last one—can we count you in?
Count me in—I’ll take 10 tons this month. We’ve all agreed, so let’s stick to that and review the reported catches together afterward.
